g.text: Only real countries: World Bank aggregates
Joined to GISCO on the ISO3 code
One row per country, indicator and year.
A missing value has no row:
The weights of one CustomIndex sum to 1.
The ranking is computed on demand
Layered architecture: these entities live in the
data layer. The backend reaches them only through
its repositories package; the services, the REST API,
the CLI and the frontend never access the database directly.
